verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Document AI solution page. It positions the product for compliance-first organizations with secure on-premises deployment and points to a public Trust Center, which suggests documents can stay in the customer's environment. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents the specific compliance controls the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit zero-retention policy for uploaded documents, SOC 2 attestation, HIPAA/BAA option, independent corroboration of the compliance claims.
